sb.default: in the default spot of the slot - click a sticker below to replace it
sb.moved: position changed - click a sticker below to replace it
sb.empty: Slot {0} is empty. Pick a sticker and it goes to the default spot.
sb.kc.empty: No charm. Pick one and it hangs in the default spot.
phint.s: Click the weapon to move sticker {0}
phint.k: Click the weapon to move the charm
se.ph: or click the weapon on the left
toast.locked: This section is only for VIP players or admins
toast.stklimit: You can use {0} of {1} sticker slots
scale.usage: Menu scale is {0}%. Pick one: !wsscale 75 (presets: {1}). 4:3 screens: 75, 5:4: 70, 16:10: 90.
toast.kc.off: A charm cannot hang here: CS2 only allows the marked spots on the weapon
toast.kc.edge: The charm cannot move further: there is no attachment spot there
toast.kc.fixed: Only the default charm spot is available for this weapon
kb.err.kcsurf: A charm cannot attach at that point: it is not on the weapon's surface
toast.offsurf: A sticker cannot go there: it is off the weapon's surface
kb.err.surf: There is no weapon surface at that point, the sticker would not show
err.data_not_loaded: The item catalogue is still loading
err.agent_cooldown: You can change the agent again in {0}s
err.style: The panorama menu is off: WeaponSkins uses another menu style (Menu_Style). Open it with !ws.
err.api: WeaponSkins with the PMM API is required (see README)
kb.h.wear: A number from {0} to {1}, for example 0.0712.
kb.h.stq: Part of the name. From "Regular stickers" it searches all stickers.
kb.h.sx: Shift from the slot's default spot. Minus is towards the muzzle, plus towards the stock. Allowed: {0} ... {1}.
kb.h.sy: Shift from the slot's default spot. Minus is up, plus is down (as in CS2). Allowed: {0} ... {1}.
kb.h.kx: Model coordinate along the weapon: more is closer to the muzzle. The point must be on the weapon's surface.
kb.h.ky: Model height: more is higher. The point must be on the weapon's surface.
kb.err.empty: Empty. Type a value or press Cancel.
kb.err.int: Enter a whole number from {0} to {1}.
ch.hint: Press Y, type and press Enter. Type "cancel" to go back without changes.
